THE EVENT

Gravelle du Parc isn’t just a race. It’s a full weekend in the best the Outaouais has to offer in October. Gravel, hills, quality food, and a party that goes late.

The Journey

The 2026 routes have been redesigned to showcase the best of the region: gravel, forests, farms, and covered bridges. Varied terrain on roads across the Outaouais, ready to ride in race or adventure mode!

Experiences

GDP is a full weekend. The race is the reason to show up. The experiences are the reason to stay.

FRIDAY EVENING - OCTOBER 2
Carb-Loading Dinner
Simon Laroche, chef at Le Caméline restaurant, is at the stove. On the menu: fresh pasta that’ll give you energy for the race and the party—infinite energy. Good music, good food, good company. That’s how we kick off a weekend at GDP.
· 6:30 p.m. to 9:30 p.m.
· Welcome remarks from the organizers at 8:00 p.m.
· Main Pavilion, Vorlage Centre
· Maximum 200 seats. $35, ticket required.
Reserve my spot
SATURDAY EVENING - OCTOBER 3
The Recovery Party
DJ Hunz in the booth, cold beer from Chelsea & Co, cocktails, non-alcoholic options, and a few surprises we’re saving for after the race. You gave it your all on the course today—now it’s time to celebrate.
· 6 p.m. to 11 p.m.
· Vorlage Centre
· Free and open to everyone!
Listen to the GDP Spotify playlist
SUNDAY MORNING - OCTOBER 4
Gourmet Brunch by Bike
We’re not telling you where we’re going. We’re just telling you it’s worth the detour. Group ride departure from Centre Vorlage, with a secret destination via Gatineau Park. The brunch waiting for you at the finish will be the cherry on top of your weekend.
· Departure at 9 a.m.
· Departure from Centre Vorlage
· 150 spots max.
· $39 · 2 tempos available
Reserve my spot

Meals + CAMPING + goodies included

Volunteers

GDP runs thanks to its volunteers. If you don’t have a bib yet, this might be the best way to experience the weekend. Meals included, official GDP shirt, access to camping, and a chance to take in the weekend vibe from the inside. Not the worst way to spend a weekend in the Outaouais.

Friday - October 2

Help with preparing refreshments, setting up the site, and serving at the Carb Load dinner. Available no later than 5:00 p.m.

Saturday - October 3

Aid stations, marshals, first aid, or on-site support. Assistance at the bar and with meal service.

Sunday - October 4

Aid stations, marshal, first aid, or on-site support.

It’s free, it’s fun, and it makes a difference. We can’t wait to see you.
